# Optuna

> > Optuna is an open-source hyperparameter optimization framework that automates machine learning model tuning through Bayesian optimization and advanced sampling strategies.

Optuna provides automated hyperparameter optimization for ML practitioners, supporting popular frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and LightGBM. The framework includes advanced features like multi-objective optimization, constrained optimization, and parallel search capabilities, with an extensible ecosystem through OptunaHub.

## Key Topics

- Hyperparameter optimization
- Bayesian optimization
- Automated search
- Sampler selection
- Multi-objective optimization
- Constrained optimization
- Parallelization
- OptunaHub
- AutoSampler
- GPSampler
- Machine learning
- Open-source
- Optuna-Dashboard
- Framework integration
- Optuna v5
